item.title: The Cosmology Crisis: is our standard model of the universe breaking?
item.description: Two headlines keep running together: JWST found galaxies that shouldn’t exist, and our two measurements of the universe’s expansion refuse to agree. Same story, we’re told. They aren’t. One is already dead, one has survived ten years of attempts to kill it, and the one most likely to rewrite the textbook wasn’t in the headline at all. A five-minute read, no astronomy needed.

item.title: Why Benjamin? A new proofreader for scientists
item.description: Every tool you ran said the manuscript was clean. Three weeks later a reviewer circled Equation 7. This is the story of why we built a proofreader that reads the science, not just the spelling, and why we gave him a name.

item.title: One flipped equation, and the Universe Eats Itself
item.description: What happens when a highly cited scientific paper accidentally rewrites the laws of physics? Discover how a tiny, invisible error slipped past peer review to create a universe that destroys itself - and the ’third eye’ built to hunt these threats down.
